title: Why Is Speculative Decoding Fast?
summary: The article explains the technical mechanics behind speculative decoding, a technique that speeds up large language model inference by using a smaller draft model to predict multiple tokens ahead, which are then verified in parallel by the larger target model.
problem_solved: Addresses the inefficiency of slow autoregressive token-by-token generation in large language models during inference.
why_valuable: It enables significant inference speedups (often 2-3x faster) without any loss in output quality, making LLM deployment more cost-effective and responsive.
